messages:
Sasha (People Ops): Hi @Alex T. — quick check: can you do a remote I-9 verification tomorrow between 10:00610:30am PT? We'll need either passport OR driver's license + SSN card. Prefer Google Meet video so we can confirm originals.
Alex T.: Hey Sasha, 10:15am PT works for me. I actually have a passport so that should be easiest. One hiccup: I didn't get the Checkr invite at my work email, I think our spam filter blocked it.
Sasha (People Ops): OK sending again to alex.t@redwood.com and to your personal email as a fallback. Checkr link: https://hr.redwood.com/checkr/abcd1234 (expires in 7d). If it still doesn't land, reply here and I'll request a manual background intake form.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: "New hire" tasks pending: I-9 (Section 2), W-4, State tax form, direct deposit. Complete before EOD day 1. Links: https://hr.redwood.com/newhire.
Alex T.: Thanks. A few extra Qs: 1) Can I do in-person verification at the SF office instead? 2) Where do I elect benefits? 3) PTO accrual starts immediately or after 30 days?
Sasha (People Ops): Short answers: 1) Yes, in-person is fine 6 bring originals to the concierge and ask for People Ops; we're onsite 9A5. 2) Benefits enrollment is in the benefits portal: https://hr.redwood.com/benefits/enroll 6 you have a 30-day window from your start date. 3) PTO accrues from day 1 but you cannot take unpaid leave that requires manager approval until your 90-day probation ends (see policy).
Ben (IT): FYI laptop is imaging tonight and will include Duo MFA + VPN profile. You'll get an automated invite to activate MFA. If you see: 
```
No network adapters found
Please contact IT
```
then DM me and I'll push a recovery image. Tracking: 1Z999AA10123456784.
Alex T.: Great, will watch for the MFA email. For the I-9: should I upload any doc photos ahead of time or just present originals on camera?
Sasha (People Ops): Present originals on camera during the live verification. We don't accept pre-uploaded photos for Section 2. If you're doing in-person we'll scan and return copies.
Alex T.: Perfect. One last: direct deposit form? I couldn't find the PDF in the welcome packet.
Sasha (People Ops): Direct deposit is in payroll portal: https://hr.redwood.com/payroll/setup 6 select "New hire" then "Add bank account". If you prefer, attach a voided check to the payroll upload.
Alex T.: Excellent, thanks everyone. See you at 10:15am PT. :thumbsup:
Ben (IT): Ping me here if the laptop doesn't boot or MFA doesn't arrive. Happy to remote in and set up Duo.
Sasha (People Ops): Closing the loop: scheduled your 10:15am PT slot and added calendar invites (I-9 meet + Day-1 orientation links). Will follow up once Checkr completes. :wave:
